item.title: Upper Ottawa Valley OPP says 'avoid unnecessary travel' due to freezing rain; All schools closed
item.description: The Upper Ottawa Valley Detachment of the Ontario Provincial Police (OPP) recommends that motorists avoid any unnecessary travel during the current freezing rain storm. item.title: $531K in Connecting Links funding for Madawaska Valley
item.description: MADAWASKA VALLEY — The Ontario government is investing more than half a million dollars through Connecting Links to help resurface a key roadway in Madawaska Valley. The province announced $531,187 in funding for the resurfacing of Opeongo Line . The Connecting Links program supports municipalities in maintaining important road and bridge connections that link local […]

item.title: Renfrew County Paramedic Service partners with hospitals for Fit2Sit program
item.description: The County of Renfrew Paramedic Service has recently teamed up with hospitals in Renfrew County to launch Fit2Sit, a program that helps return paramedics to service within the community as quickly as possible after transporting a patient to hospital by ambulance.
